PR54 native-POST follow-up merged at fa510d4edb1bb6ffc071d8bc7d59f71b9105ed2b. - Ported behavior: bundled web/inquiry-config.json reaches the Python projector Lambda; GATSBY_PROSPECTUS_INTAKE_URL cannot. Form requires HTTPS endpoint plus approved notice/version together, stays disabled in this deployment, preserves Google Form in all states, reuses IDs for retries, filters campaign metadata, omits credentials/marketing enrollment, and only acknowledges server receipts. Native fallback uses POST so inquiry data cannot become query strings.
- Tests: initial new spec failed for missing inquiry module; final 3 rendering, 3 JS submission, 4 page-generation, 5 environment and 13 edge tests pass (28 total). Whitespace checks pass. Full build/backend and synchronous re-render are the existing Amplify pipeline; job26 running and job27 queued at the time of this progress note. Final deployment/public receipts follow.
- Upstream blocker: Prospectus PR19 remains OPEN at 76f5eb47f52995498cfcdb9e06efe23ff340614a (CI green), tracking Prospectus kanbus-47dc15ae. Real-contact intake activation, approved privacy/retention and grants are outside this Anth.us-only exception. No Prospectus writes or real inquiry submissions performed. Do not close the parent or call the disabled form live/complete.
- Original M1 Gatsby clone moved intact from /Users/home/Projects/Anth.us to /Users/home/Backups/retired-projects/Anth.us-20261017. All 159,904 entries preserved, move manifest zero differences; all seven worktree HEAD/status snapshots, refs, and two stashes match before/after.
